title: First holo made with YAGna laser

posts.topic_title: First holo made with YAGna laser
posts.author: glajciorz
posts.post_subject: First holo made with YAGna laser
posts.content_md:
![Image](http://www.unipress.waw.pl/~sarzyn/kostka4.gif)

Nd:YAG passively q-switched SSY1-based YAGna laser with 5x5x5mm KTP crystal

10mJ energy

4ns exposure time

VRP-M film

15s development in JD4

90s bleaching in Fe-EDTA

visible over 60deg. range and not bright at all 

The object is a dice 

greetings

Adam
